description.value: General Practice (GP) Managed Print Services. The current fleet is approximately 7,800 devices, the majority of which require a solution based on USB connectivity. Procurement to cover the following themes: Print Hardware and Installation; Print Consumables; Training and Documentation for Practices; Management of Print Assets and Print Availability (Break/Fix Services); Provision of Print Activity Reporting and Analytics, including reporting by media type at enterprise, site, and device level, to support operational management, cost transparency, and sustainability objectives. Digital Health Care Wales (DHCW) intends to conduct market engagement with providers who may be interested in bidding for the GP Managed Print Service Contract. DHCW has not defined a route to market and welcomes engagement from potential providers. DHCW intends to conduct a market engagement presentation session in mid June via a digital platform, followed by possible individual question and answer sessions.
